title: Import absences from a spreadsheet
description: Record past vacations, sick days and other leave for several people at once. Each row becomes an approved absence with the leave type's usual rules.
format: Use a CSV file (export it from Excel or Google Sheets) with the columns Person, Type, Start, End and, if you like, Note. Dates are 2026-07-06 or 06.07.2026. A row with only a start date is one day.
readError: The file could not be read. Save it as CSV (UTF-8) and try again.
missingColumns: The first row must name these columns: {{columns}}.
matchHelp: These names do not match a person or leave type exactly. Choose the right one, or skip those rows.
summary: {{ready}} ready to import, {{exists}} already recorded, {{invalid}} need attention.
note: Rows already in Time off are skipped, so you can run the same file again. Balances and capacity update as soon as a row is imported.
approveNegative: Also import rows that take a balance below zero
negativeNotApproved: Takes the balance below zero. Tick the box above to import it anyway.
uncertain: The last import may have been saved. Retry the exact submission before changing the file or closing; no further rows were sent.
